metadata.name: cachain
metadata.description: Founder Village asset tokenization: eligibility gate, bounties, contributions and pull distributions on Token-2022

instructions.name: create_asset
docs: Creates the asset account and its USDC vaults from the policy numbers in the config file.

instructions.name: create_mints
docs: Creates both Token-2022 mints with their fixed extension set and makes the asset live.

instructions.name: execute
docs: SPL transfer-hook `execute`, called by Token-2022 on every profit-token transfer.

accounts.name: destination_position
docs: Same account as `source_position` when an owner moves tokens between its own accounts.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: is re-derived and the contents parsed in `sas::standing`.

types.name: Asset
docs: One tokenized asset (one SPE). Every policy number lives here, written once from the config file.

fields.name: council
docs: Signs curation, acceptance, pauses and outflows. A Squads vault in every deployment.

fields.name: holding
docs: Owner of the holding's token accounts; receives `holding_bps` of every issuance.

fields.name: spe_treasury
docs: The only token account capital may leave to (the SPE's account).

fields.name: contribution_mint
docs: USDC on mainnet; a local or devnet mint elsewhere.

fields.name: credential
docs: Solana Attestation Service credential and schema the eligibility gate accepts.

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain description of the deliverable.

fields.name: raised
docs: Financial: USDC received.

fields.name: minted
docs: Asset tokens minted to members by this bounty, holding split excluded.

fields.name: claimant
docs: Work: the member who claimed it.

fields.name: delivery_hash
docs: Work: hash of what was delivered.

types.name: Distribution
docs: Pull-distribution accumulator over profit-token balances the program tracks itself.

fields.name: reward_index
docs: Cumulative income per profit-token base unit, scaled by `math::INDEX_SCALE`.

fields.name: tracked_supply
docs: Sum of every `Position::balance`. Equals profit supply minus burned tokens.

fields.name: carry
docs: Income recorded while `tracked_supply` was zero, folded into the next inflow.

fields.name: contributed
docs: USDC received into the capital vault through `contribute`.

fields.name: outflow
docs: USDC sent from the capital vault to the SPE through `record_outflow`.

fields.name: income
docs: USDC received into the income vault through `record_inflow`.

fields.name: income_claimed
docs: USDC paid from the income vault through `claim_distribution`.

types.name: MintKind
docs: Which of the asset's two tokens a mint is. The byte is the PDA seed of the mint.

types.name: Position
docs: One holder's share of the profit-token distribution.

fields.name: balance
docs: Profit tokens this owner holds across all of their token accounts.

fields.name: index
docs: `Distribution::reward_index` at the last settlement.

fields.name: accrued
docs: Income earned and not yet claimed.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Income paid out over the position's life.

types.name: Receipt
docs: Receipt of one USDC contribution to a financial bounty.

types.name: Terms
docs: The exchange, fixed at curation and never written again.

fields.name: reward
docs: Work: asset tokens (base units, before the holding split) paid on settlement.

fields.name: price_num
docs: Financial: asset tokens minted per contribution = amount * price_num / price_den.

fields.name: target
docs: Financial: most USDC the bounty accepts.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Financial: unix time after which contributions are refused; 0 means none.
